description: This file is a Perl script named 'packinfo.pl'. It processes input data from 'git verify-pack -v' output, providing statistics and optional tree and filename information about Git pack files, such as object sizes, delta chains, and object depths.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (count, total, min, max, mean, median, standard deviation) for a list of numeric data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints statistical metrics for a dataset with a descriptive label.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses delta trees starting from a root object, collecting size and path size statistics; optionally outputs tree structure if '-tree' flag is set.
